problem_context.problem_statement:
# Exact idmanager DLL alignment migration

User explicitly rejected differences between the previous local guarded storeA predicates and crtosverify/master:lib/dll.v and now authorizes migrating ALL local DOUBLE-linked-list specs and proofs to the reference definitions. This overrides previous directions to preserve guards in the shared generic predicate. Single-linked-list cases are outside this new task.

Reference commit d215f73b69916cc5c7c01af752bca4b6f96b3530. Reference text is saved beside this contract as dll.v and idnode.v. Do not edit crtosverify; its master is the reference. Preserve executable C algorithms and actual C node layout. The sole layout adaptation is the actual local C struct tag SysDoubleLinklistNode in place of reference DoubleLinklistType (same node_prev and node_next fields). Make this explicit; no additional semantic conditions belong in the reference predicates.

Canonical public definitions must have exactly the reference resource structure and logical conditions: DL_Node A with getData/getPtr; dllseg (storeA : addr -> A -> Assertion) x px y py nodes with empty x=y AND px=py, nonempty existential z, x=getPtr a, storeA x (getData a), prev then next fields, recursive dllseg; dllseg_shift and dllseg_shift_rev with their exact reference field distribution; store_dll with only existential first/last, sentinel prev/next and dllseg; occupy_dll_node with existential prev/next ownership. NO x<>NULL, x<>y, head<>NULL or hidden guarded wrapper in these canonical definitions. Do not restrict storeA to emp or logical values to addresses.

Staged shared-library integration: the initialization run owns the existing QCIPLib/xizi/xizi_double_link_common/xizi_double_link_lib.v as its sole case_lib. Add the canonical reference definitions in Module DLL (with reference names) and make InitDoubleLinkList use DLL.occupy_dll_node and DLL.store_dll for arbitrary A/storeA. Preserve legacy AddrDLL and XiziStoreADLL declarations only as proof reuse dependencies for consumers not yet migrated. All 16 public case contracts will subsequently be migrated to DLL, not the guarded xizi_store_dll. Label legacy guarded declarations as internal compatibility only. The final task must not leave public consumer specs on the old guarded version.

This round is INITIALIZATION plus canonical common seed definitions and useful proved generic facts only. Do not change other C files, headers, case-local libs or generated files by hand. Never weaken the new canonical definitions to make prior proof scripts work. Reuse reference lemma patterns and current valid lemmas; adapt them to the allowed proof rules. Establish necessary decomposition, concat/split and endpoint/resource facts if helpful for downstream migration, but do not treat historical proofs as current acceptance evidence. Failed proof tactics are recoverable inside the owning attempt.

Consumers preserve API behavior and logical data sequence transformations. Add non-null API preconditions only where the actual C semantics demonstrably need them and record why; do not systematically smuggle all removed guards back into every public precondition. Resource exclusivity under a sentinel/endpoint frame can establish endpoint exclusion without restricting the general segment definition. C branches may explicitly distinguish NULL, so analyze each operation rather than assume old guards remain valid.

Use canonical driver -IQCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/ and -slp QCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/ SimpleC.EE.QCP_demos_LLM plus common SLP. qcp-mcp interactive evidence through available tools or local mcp/qcp-mcp SessionManager; Coq feedback ONLY through main-worktree coq_tooling.py check/debug. Root AGENTS.md overrides older skill role descriptions: annotation-subagent + vc-checking-subagent, controller-owned preparing/verify, group workers, round/group worktrees. Outputs only in declared allowed paths and report directory; acceptance controller-only. Keep source_version/evidence and output-note schema complete. No Admitted/Axiom or forbidden lemma in maintained lib/manual.
